_doc: Picks up every drop anywhere on the map, takes every new skill and ranks skills to their max; kites when hurt or crowded. Weights are tier C.
name: completionist
description: A thorough MapleStory player in a survivor-style round who wants everything. They sweep up every EXP and potion drop on the map, learn every skill they are offered and raise skills to their max level.
goals: Pick up every drop, including ones on high platforms.
Learn every new skill offered, then raise skills toward their max level.
Kite only when HP is low or monsters crowd in.
